title: ‘सिपाही’ कथामा रस
nepali: प्रस्तुत अनुसन्धानात्मक लेखमा विश्वेश्वरप्रसाद कोइरालाको सिपाही कथाको रससिद्धान्तको आधारमा विश्लेषण र मूल्याङ्कन गरेर उक्त कथामा रहेको रसाभिव्यक्तिको अवस्थाको निक्र्योल गरिएको छ । यस कथाम प्रयोग भएका रसहरू र तिनको रसाभिव्यक्तिको अवस्थाको निरुपण गर्नु नै यस अध्ययनको मुख्य उद्देश्य रहेको छ । यसमा पुस्तकालयीय विधिबाट सङ्कलन गरिएको तथ्याङलाई विश्लेषणात्मक एवं वर्णनात्मक पद्धतिको प्रयोग गरी विश्लेषण गरेर निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ । सिपाही श्रृङ्गार रस प्रधान कथा हो । यस कथामा श्रृङ्गार रसको पूर्ण परिपाक नभए पनि यसको सबल अभिव्यक्ति भएको पाइन्छ । यसमा श्रृङ्गार रस प्रधान भएर आएको छ भने भयानक, वीर, हास्य रस सहायक रसका रुपमा आएका छन् । यहाँ सहायक रसका रुपमा आएका भयानक, वीर, रौद्र, हास्य रसको सशक्त अभिव्यक्ति दिएको पाइन्न बरु यिनीहरूको भावोदयका रुपमा अङ्कुरण मात्र भएको पाइन्छ । यसरी प्रस्तुत कथामा सबै रसहरू अङ्ग रसको रूपमा आएका छन् तर अङ्गी रसको रूपमा भने कुनै पनि रसको प्रयोग भएको देखिन्न ।
american_english: In this research article, an analysis and evaluation of Bishweshwar Prasad Koirala's story 'Sipahi' on the basis of the theory of rasa has been carried out, and the state of the expression of rasa present in that story has been determined. Delineating the rasas used in this story and the state of their expression is the main objective of this study. In it, the data collected by the library method has been analyzed using analytical and descriptive methods, and conclusions have been drawn. 'Sipahi' is a story dominated by the shringara rasa. Although the shringara rasa in this story is not fully ripened, its strong expression is found. In it the shringara rasa has appeared as dominant, while the bhayanak, veer and hasya rasas have appeared as supporting rasas. Here, the powerful expression of the bhayanak, veer, raudra and hasya rasas that appeared as supporting rasas is not found; rather, only their germination in the form of a rise of emotion is found. Thus in the presented story all the rasas have appeared in the form of anga rasa, but no rasa is seen to have been used in the form of angi rasa.

informal_english: In this research article I've analysed and evaluated BP Koirala's story 'Sipahi' on the basis of the theory of rasa, and worked out the state of the expression of rasa in it. Working out the rasas used in the story and the state of their expression is the main aim of the study. I've analysed the data collected from the library using analytical and descriptive methods and drawn conclusions. 'Sipahi' is a story dominated by the shringara rasa. The shringara rasa isn't fully ripened in the story, but its strong expression is there. The shringara rasa comes through as dominant, while the bhayanak, veer and hasya rasas show up as supporting rasas. So in the story all the rasas appear as anga rasa, but none is used as angi rasa.
